Clearstone Engineering Ltd. and Carleton University (2018). Update of Equipment, Component and Fugitive Emission Factors for Alberta Upstream Oil and Gas. Technical report prepared for the Alberta Energy Regulator, Calgary, 10 June 2018.

Loaded (main): per-device natural-gas vent rates for six gas-driven pneumatic device types (Table 16) and reciprocating compressor rod-packing leak rates (Table 9 population average; manufacturer good-condition range, Sect. 4.4.4). Emission values are whole-gas (natural gas) or total-hydrocarbon (THC) volumes/masses written under target ch4 - NOT pure CH4; convert with the gas CH4 fraction. Rates are per device-hour, not per unit of product. Other-values: Table 9 component population-average leak factors (connectors, valves, etc.), rod-packing leaker factor, ECCC 2014 pneumatic rates. Not loaded: equipment/component/pneumatic counts per facility subtype and well status (Tables 3-8; an inventory-model input, not technology data), leaker factors for components (Table 10), uncertainty method. Table 16 vent rates are not measured in this campaign - they are weighted averages of Prasino 2013 and Spartan 2018. References are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 28).
